title: Editing caret
description: A short note types, pauses and corrects one detail with a caret attached to the actual string.
useCase: Make a deliberate textual revision visible as a finite sequence.
reducedMotion: The complete corrected note is shown immediately; no typing or blinking loop.
limitations: A fixed editorial sentence and timing sequence, not an editable rich-text engine or streaming transport.
look: Warm off-white page with a large dark serif note, its corrected phrase in red, a thin red left margin rule and small monospace labels.
motion: On press, the note types character by character (46–85 ms each) with a red caret, holds 850 ms, backspaces past the wrong word, then retypes the ending in red.
adapt: The sequence is precomputed into `script` (each step a `text` snapshot with an `ms` delay and `revision` flag) and stepped by the `requestAnimationFrame` `tick`. Set `prefix`, `oldWord`, `newWord`, `suffix` and the `ec-sr` copy for your sentence; tune the `ms` formulas.
